agent_explanation: After a high-speed fall and floor bounce (step 180 speed ~12.7), the body with large radius 0.96 retains vx~2.71 and bounces low near the floor (y~1.07-1.19). Substep count drops to 2 per step while traversing toward the right arena boundary. The arena boundary collision/positional correction fails to keep the centre at least -r+0.15 inside; overshoot grows from -0.0006 at step 190 to 0.088 at 192, 0.133 at 193, exceeding tolerance 0.15 at step 194 with 0.178. Likely cause is simultaneous floor contact and right-boundary contact with too few substeps/weak correction for large radius, letting x drift outside.
